        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])

def f(inp):
    i=np.array(inp); H,W=i.shape
    cnt=collections.Counter(i.flatten()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; mv=cnt.most_common()[-1][0]
    out=i.copy()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
